desc: The Bergara BMR-X Carbon is purpose-built for small game hunters seeking precision, portability, and ergonomic excellence. Featuring the lightweight yet durable carbon fiber barrel, this rifle offers the ideal balance for field carry and quick, precise shots. The adjustable length-of-pull (LOP) stock, vertical grip, included 30 MOA rail, and flat forend deliver unmatched control and customization, ensuring comfort and accuracy in every scenario. Powered by the scaled-down Bergara Micro Rimfire action and a precision match chamber, the BMR-X Carbon delivers unparalleled performance in its class. With its lighter build and premium features, it’s the perfect choice for hunters looking for precision without compromise.
